turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hey, nice to hear from you. How are you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I've been sleeping badly, and I want to try something new. Can you help me pick?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hear me out on all the options before you comment.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: The first idea is going to bed at exactly the same time every night, even on weekends.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Then there's no screens for an hour before bed and reading a paper book instead.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Option three is buying a white noise machine because my street is pretty loud at night.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: And the last one is cutting out coffee after lunch, which would be really hard for me.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: And that's the last one. What do you think?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Since your street is loud, the white noise machine might give you the quickest improvement. A steady bedtime is one of the most reliable habits for better sleep in general. Cutting afternoon coffee is tough, but it can make a real difference.
